# Documentation profile

Read [root policy](../../AGENTS.md), [conventions](../../docs/CONVENTIONS.md)
and relevant domain documentation. Inspect current implementation before writing.

- Keep documentation in English; retain Portuguese domain names and actual routes.
- Separate implemented behavior, proposals, historical evidence and unverified deployment.
- Keep root policy concise; maintain durable inventory in `docs/SYSTEM_STATE.md`.
- Verify local links and context budgets with the governance preset.
- A documentation-only request does not authorize application source changes.
